updates.sentence: Sentenced to twenty-five years, reduced to one year. The archive explicitly records arrival at CampMeade September27,1917, conscientious objection declaration and immediate arrest that day. This is the start of military detention, not a separately verified Leavenworth transfer date. Actual release date and total confinement remain unresolved; the prior1918year endpoint was not corroborated and is not calculated from a nominal one-year sentence. Source: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1pW6wsZo4it4CTtGmn_P-dwg1L0arJBfJEhwcIZlSZNQ/edit (MorrisTrasken,row2085).
